purpose: Audit goal coverage, source and retained evidence; correct maintained build plan without changing game scope.
method: Local requirement coverage plus focused source inspection and evidence reconciliation. All 55 chapters have a guide route and all 35 top-level goals have a status. Additional content inventories remain in guide section 19. Hashes identify reviewed source/evidence baselines, not a claim that every source line was reviewed or every test rerun. A chapter route is not implementation completion.

Android 15/API35 16KB x86_64 emulator with ARM translation and three Windows clients. No physical Android/iPad, host migration or offline merge claim.
Windows native Bonjour/DTLS proof on one PC, IPv4; no physical device or automatic recovery qualification
Native Windows Bonjour/DTLS and actual UI input. Foreground adapter is simulated; no physical mobile, host migration or offline merge claim.
Four native Windows clients; simulated lifecycle input calls the shared foreground adapter. Not physical iOS suspension, iPad hosting or offline reunion.
Native screenshot inspected, exact installed APK/signature verified, enrollment reused, branch save checks in separate evidence; no new physical speech/multitouch qualification.

Original local primary/backup are byte-identical. Paired solo primary/backup retain world, player identity and all existing item fields; resetPending=false is additive. Player position advanced through 21 accepted movement commands between observations. No restore/rollback performed. Android private settings not directly readable.
Wire compatibility and basic interaction; older clients do not display the new reset cue. Older servers do not implement timers.
Native Windows four-client test; lifetime boundary uses an explicit verification-only elapsed offset. Not a two-hour wall-clock soak or physical-device restart acceptance.
